{{Quote|With the shield down the planetary defenses can take care of the rest!|Skywalker explains to Tano that their work on Gall is done|<ref name="IJ" />}}
A '''planetary defense force''' existed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gall/Legends|Gall]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. They fought the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] during the [[Battle of Gall|battle]] fought on Gall during the war, but needed aid from the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to defeat them.

==Description==
A military force defended the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gall/Legends|Gall]]. They wore [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and made use of [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] and [[Gall starfighter|starships]] in their forces.<ref name="IJ" />

==History==
{{Quote|Our blasters can't penetrate the shield, but the droids are having no problem blasting us to shreds through it!|The sergeant describes the battle to Tano and Skywalker|<ref name="IJ" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], a [[Battle of Gall (Clone Wars)|battle]] was fought on Gall between the two forces, with the defense force siding with the Republic, fighting the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] invading their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. The force made use of [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] and a number of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] in their defense, but could not damage the [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] that the Separatists were using due to a shield protecting the vehicles. The shield did not prevent the Separatists firing on the defense force however, and their fire began reducing their numbers. A [[Unidentified Gall sergeant|sergeant]] serving in the defense force complained of the issue to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who had been sent by the Republic to help in the battle, and the pair of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] then used [[jet-wing]]s vehicles to penetrate the shields and destroy the lead Separatist craft, which was [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|generating]] the shield. With the shield down the Jedi then let the defense forces finish off the vulnerable Separatists left.<ref name="IJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The force first appeared in ''[[Inside Job]]'' a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] written by [[Rik Hoskin]] and illustrated by [[Andres Ponce]], which was published in [[2009]] in issue [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.1|6.1]] of of the [[Star Wars Comic|''Star Wars Comic UK'']] magazine series.
